subject: Semantic Search cutover plan: phased backfill & rerank QA
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Handoff: Acme semantic search migration & initial backfill estimates

Hi Priya / Marissa,

Handoff for Acme (ACME-4578) — they're ready to move from their legacy vector infra into our hosted semantic-search + rerank stack. Attached are two artifacts I compiled during the deal: a back-of-envelope backfill estimate (backfill-estimates.csv) and a cutover checklist (cutover-checklist.xlsx).

Key points upfront:
- Current corpus size: ~18M documents, ~12 tokens avg per doc for embedding windowing.
- Current vector store: Pinecone (medium provisioned index). They want a gradual cutover to avoid spikes to their app.
- Must keep warm fallback to their Pinecone index for at least 2 weeks post-cutover.

Immediate asks for CS/implementation:
1) Confirm recommended index approach (hosted vector store vs customer-managed Weaviate cluster).
2) Proposed backfill throughput and estimate for total wall-clock time. My estimate assumes 8 workers at 200 docs/sec -> ~2.5 days but depends on batching and IO.
3) Rerank evaluation plan: they'll want quality gates (MRR >= 0.62, recall@10 >= 0.82) before traffic shift.

Can we schedule a 30-min kickoff next week? Also cc'ing Monica since she'll be the success lead if we proceed.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: Acme semantic search migration & initial backfill estimates

Thanks Karthik — this is helpful. A couple quick clarifying Qs before I loop in the customer:

- Can you confirm the backfill estimate assumptions (network egress, whether embeddings are computed on the fly or provided)? The CSV has a few columns but I want the exact breakdown so I can present a timeline to Acme.
- For the vector store recommendation: do we have any constraints from their security team if we recommend hosted (VPC peering) vs self-managed? I know Acme asked for an option to keep keys on their side.
- Rerank gates: are those thresholds already validated against a small eval set, or do we need to build a holdout set first?

I can hold internal kickoff on Wednesday (11/24) 10:00am PT. If that works, I'll invite Acme and draft a mutual action plan.

- Priya
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Tim Morales <tim.morales@acmeretail.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Search Team <search@acmeretail.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T08:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: Acme semantic search migration & initial backfill estimates

Hi Priya / team,

Thanks for the documents. A few constraints on our side:
- We compute embeddings in our pipeline today; we can hand them off as a bulk export (we estimate ~48GB compressed) if that helps speed the backfill.
- Security: must use customer-managed KMS for key material; we can do VPC peering but prefer our keys not be exported.
- Cutover window: prefer low-traffic weekend (Sat 2am–6am PT) for the write-heavy portion. We want incremental canary traffic starting at 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 72 hours if quality gates are met.

We agree on the fallback requirement to Pinecone for 14 days. Happy to be on Wed 11/24 10am PT kickoff — we can add our platform engineer (J. Morales) to answer infra questions.

Best,
Tim Morales
Director, Search Engineering
Acme Retail

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Tim Morales <tim.morales@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: Acme semantic search migration & initial backfill estimates

Thanks all — nice to meet you, Tim. Looping in the implementation plan and a short rerank evaluation doc (rerank-eval-plan.md) outlining the quality gates and test harness we'll run against Acme's holdout queries. High level:

- Eval plan: we'll run A/B rerank tests on a 5k-query holdout. Metrics: MRR, recall@10, nDCG@10. Passing criteria: MRR >= 0.62 AND nDCG@10 delta >= -0.02 vs baseline.
- Canary plan: traffic ramp 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 72 hrs if eval passes. We'll run manual checks after each step and sample logs for latency/regression.
- Backfill approach: prefer ingesting precomputed embeddings from Acme (they said export is available). We'll run parallel workers from our hosted backfill service. If they cannot provide embeddings, we'll compute them on our side which adds ~30% to the time.

Action items I propose for the kickoff:
1) Karthik: finalize backfill throughput numbers and expected IOPS.
2) Acme (Tim / JMorales): confirm KMS/VPC constraints and share export link for embeddings.
3) Priya / Monica: own cutover communications, rollback plan, and post-cutover QA.

Attachments: rerank-eval-plan.md

-Marissa
Implementation Lead, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tim Morales <tim.morales@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-26T14:35:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: Acme semantic search migration & initial backfill estimates

Following up with technical assumptions and a short runbook link (cutover-runbook.pdf):

Assumptions used to produce backfill-estimates.csv: 
- Embedding payload: 48GB compressed provided by Acme.
- Worker config: 8 backfill workers, CPU-bound embedding ingestion, disk I/O to our blob store at ~500MB/s aggregated.
- If Acme hands off embeddings: estimated wall-clock backfill = 28–32 hours (including indexing and small verification). If we compute embeddings: +10–12 hours for compute.
- Throttling: we'll set client-side batching at 512 docs per request with concurrency of 24 to keep memory use predictable.

Fallback and rollback plan (summary):
1) Canary at 5% with live shadowing of Pinecone; verify top-k responses and latency.
2) If MRR drop > 0.03 or p95 latency degrade > 250ms vs baseline, we pause cutover and fail back to Pinecone routing.
3) Post-cutover: keep Pinecone in passive mode for 14 days; nightly sync to ensure no drift.

Runbook link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bCutoverPlan (cutover-runbook.pdf)

I'll be on the kickoff to walk infra/throughput.

-Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Tim Morales <tim.morales@acmeretail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, J. Morales <jmorales@acmeretail.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Semantic Search cutover plan: phased backfill & rerank QA

All — thanks for the quick turnaround and for confirming constraints. Summary of decisions and next steps (finalized):

Decisions:
- Vector store: hosted Redwood-managed index with VPC peering; Acme will retain KMS encryption keys (customer-managed).
- Embeddings: Acme will upload precomputed embeddings to the shared S3 link before Friday 12/04. This enables the faster backfill path.
- Backfill window: Saturday 12/12 02:00–10:00 PT (primary bulk indexing). Canary ramp: 5% (immediately after indexing) -> 25% at T+24h -> 100% at T+72h if gates pass.
- Quality gates: MRR >= 0.62 AND nDCG@10 delta >= -0.02. p95 latency target <= baseline + 250ms.

Owners / action owners:
- Karthik: finalize worker config and be on-call for backfill (done).
- Marissa: run rerank evaluation harness and report results after each canary step.
- Monica / Priya: cutover comms and rollback execution.
- Acme (Tim / JMorales): provide embeddings export link and confirm KMS peering details by 2026-12-04.

Kickoff call scheduled: Wed 2026-11-24 10:00am PT (calendar invite sent). Please review the attached cutover-checklist.xlsx and cutover-runbook.pdf. I'll open a mutual action plan in HubSpot and mark milestones.

If anyone sees issues with the timeline or the gates, reply-all and we'll adjust.

Regards,
Priya Natanajan
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
